'''Jiro Saito''' ('''斉藤 次郎''' ''Saitō Jirō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Saito was born on May 24 in {{wp|Tochigi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where his only role was [[Mohn]], father of both {{an|Lillie}} and {{an|Gladion}} and husband of [[Lusamine]]. Saito is currently affiliated with talent agency Kenyuu Office.
